title: A1 Final Review Part 1: To Be & Present Simple
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has superado con éxito la primera parte del Gran Repaso Final de A1.

stages.title: Gran Repaso: To Be y Present Simple

parts.visual: Verbo To Be (Ser/Estar): I am (I'm), You are (You're), He/She/It is (He's). Negativo: I am not, You aren't, He isn't. Preguntas: Are you...? Is she...? Se usa para descripciones, ubicaciones y estados.
parts.audio: Verb To Be: I am, You are, He is. Negative: I am not, You aren't, He isn't. Questions: Are you? Is she? We use it for descriptions, locations, and states.

parts.visual: Present Simple (Rutinas y Hechos): I/You/We/They work. He/She/It works (con 's'). Negativo: don't / doesn't. Preguntas: Do / Does. Se usa con adverbios de frecuencia (always, never, usually).
parts.audio: Present Simple for routines and facts: I work. He works, with an S. Negative: don't and doesn't. Questions: Do and Does. Used with frequency adverbs like always and never.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del verbo To Be o Present Simple.

questions.question: They ____ not from the London office.
____ the CEO in a meeting right now?
questions.explanation: The CEO (He/She) lleva Is para el verbo To Be.

questions.question: She ____ every day at 8:00 AM. (Empieza - Rutina).
questions.explanation: Present Simple para rutinas. She/He/It lleva 's'.

questions.question: I ____ my emails in the morning. (Reviso).
questions.explanation: I/You/We/They no llevan 's' en Present Simple.

questions.question: ____ you work on Saturdays? (Rutina).
questions.explanation: Pregunta de rutina con You lleva el auxiliar Do.

questions.question: ____ he have the report? (¿Él tiene...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta de rutina con He/She/It lleva el auxiliar Does.

questions.question: We ____ work on Sundays. (No trabajamos).
questions.explanation: Negativo de Present Simple con We = don't.

questions.question: She ____ like the new software. (No le gusta).
I ____ late for work. (Nunca llego tarde).
questions.explanation: Con el verbo To Be, el adverbio va DESPUÉS (am never).

questions.question: I ____ late. (Nunca trabajo hasta tarde).
questions.explanation: Con otros verbos (work), el adverbio va ANTES (never work).

questions.question: The meeting ____ at 10:00 AM every Monday.
The meeting ____ at 10:00 AM every Monday. (Empieza).
Where ____ the headquarters? (¿Dónde están...?).
questions.explanation: Headquarters (Sede) usualmente es plural: are the headquarters.

questions.question: How often ____ you check your email?

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra correcta (am, is, are, do, does, don't, doesn't, o el verbo con 's').

questions.question: We ____ work on Sundays. (Negativo de Present Simple)
She ____ like it. (Negativo de Present Simple)

pairs.target: Yo soy (o estoy) / Yo no soy
Él es (o está) / Él no es
Ellos son (o están) / Ellos no son

pairs.source: I am never / I never work

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am the new marketing manager.
options: I am the new marketing manager.
I am the new sales manager.
He is the new marketing manager.
She is the new marketing manager.
questions.correct_answer: I am the new marketing manager.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Is the CEO in a meeting right now?
options: Is the CEO in a meeting right now?
Are they in a meeting right now?
Is the manager in a meeting right now?
Is he in a meeting right now?
questions.correct_answer: Is the CEO in a meeting right now?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She starts every day at 8 AM.
options: She starts every day at 8 AM.
He starts every day at 8 AM.
I start every day at 8 AM.
She starts every day at 9 AM.
questions.correct_answer: She starts every day at 8 AM.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She doesn't like the new software.
options: She doesn't like the new software.
He doesn't like the new software.
I don't like the new software.
She doesn't use the new software.
questions.correct_answer: She doesn't like the new software.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am never late for work.
options: I am never late for work.
He is never late for work.
I never arrive late for work.
questions.correct_answer: I am never late for work.
